question: How do I register?
whatsapp:
Hello! You can register online at millionairemind.live — simply select your preferred event and follow the steps.

If you need help completing your registration, feel free to reach out and we'll guide you through it.
email:
Hello,

question: When does registration close?
whatsapp:
Hello! Online registration closes before the event. On-site registration is available on Friday and on Saturday until 12pm (noon).

We recommend registering early to secure your preferred ticket type and any early bird pricing.
email:
Hello,

Thank you for your question.

Online registration closes before the event begins.

If you wish to register on-site, registration is available on Friday and Saturday until 12:00 PM (noon). After 12:00 PM on Saturday, no new registrations will be accepted.

We recommend registering early to secure your preferred ticket type and any available promotional pricing.

Best regards,

question: Can I register on Saturday?
whatsapp:
Hello! Yes — on-site registration is open on Saturday until 12pm (noon). After that, no new participants will be admitted.

We strongly recommend arriving from Friday as many important lessons begin on Day 1 and build throughout the weekend.
email:
Hello,

Thank you for your question.

Yes, you can register on Saturday. On-site registration is available until 12:00 PM (noon). After that time, no new participants will be admitted.

We strongly recommend attending from Friday, as the programme is designed to build progressively over all three days, and many important lessons begin on Day 1.

Best regards,

question: What time does registration open on event day?
whatsapp:
Hello! On-site registration opens before the session begins on Friday. VIP participants can check in from 8am on Saturday for the Networking Session.

We recommend arriving early to complete registration comfortably before sessions begin.
email:
Hello,

Thank you for your question.

On Friday, on-site registration is open from 7:45 AM to 8:45 AM, before the programme begins at 9:00 AM.

For VIP participants, the Speed Networking Session begins at 8:00 AM on Saturday.

We recommend arriving early to complete registration comfortably before the sessions begin.

Best regards,
